what: A public gallery for scratch-pad drawings made in the Roost carrier-pigeon messaging app. Art arrives by bot, and users rank and tag chirps. Repo README.md:1-5.
audience: Roost app users who send drawings, and visitors who browse the gallery.
landing_job: The site root (/) is the recent-art gallery, not a marketing landing page. Its job is to show the gallery and link to sign-up and how-to pages (site/src/index.js:53-68).

surfaces.where: site/ (Cloudflare Worker and D1, gallery HTML rendered in site/src/index.js)

brand_family: Roost (shares the Roost scratch-pad palette with roost_sim/viewer.html and controller/RoostDraw)

identity.look: Dark, flat gallery with navy cards, gold links and rounded tiles, all in the system font. The Mac viewer and drawing app use a separate light grey palette, so the two surfaces do not match.

notes: No design system or brand book exists. No claude.ai artifact or design URL is in the repo. The site has no logo, only an emoji in the header (site/src/index.js:54). The site is dark, while roost_sim and RoostDraw are light. The spec says RoostDraw.icns is absent, but the file exists. Verify before use.
